name: Kiln-Priest

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The kiln-priest makes three attacks, using Radiant Flame or Mace in any combination.

Actions.name: Radiant Flame
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 ft. 26 (6d6 + 5) Radiant damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
The kiln-priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** *Light*, *Thaumaturgy*
- **1/Day Each:** *Spirit Guardians*

Actions.name: Mace
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: The kiln-priest casts *Bless*, *Dispel Magic*, *Healing Word*, or *Lesser Restoration*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Traits.name: Sermon of the Branded Cinder II
Traits.text: While Bloodied, the kiln-priest's Radiant Flame attacks mark each target they hit with a clinging brand of fire, and the kiln-priest knows the location of every branded creature and can see it through mundane stone or smoke, so a branded creature cannot hide from the kiln-priest by those means.
Traits.clause: The kiln-priest is half-consumed by its own kiln. While Bloodied, heat pours from the cracked glass of its skin: its Cen
Traits.expressedQuote: the kiln-priest's Radiant Flame attacks mark each target they hit with a clinging brand of fire

lore: Once the keeper of a temple's firing kiln, this priest kept praying while the flames took the congregation and now wanders to convert the living by burning the prayers into them.
